text:
Alyssa: Ok this is peak office AI culture — I fed the office fridge's sticky note into a prompt and asked for 'melodramatic breakup note from the fridge' and it delivered. :cry:

Alyssa: ```Dear You, I have chilled your leftovers for years and you repay me with mystery Tupperwares and expired milk. I am cold, but my feelings are colder. Please stop leaving things with no labels. Sincerely, The Refrigerator.```

Devon: omg this is the note my microwave would write if it had feelings :rofl:

Sam: please escalate to HR immediately, fridge is passive-aggressive and emotionally unavailable :sob:

Leah: also — pizza poll for Friday lunch? We can bribe the fridge with toppings. :pizza: React with 🍕 for pepperoni, 🧀 for veggie, 🌶️ for something wild

Noah: 🍕 (pepperoni forever)

Jordan: 🧀 (veggie, but with extra olives)

Alyssa: opsbot do we have a way to schedule a calendar invite for lunch + fridge therapy session? @opsbot

opsbot: @Alyssa Sure — creating event "Fridge Intervention & Pizza" for Friday 12:30pm. Calendar invite sent to #random.

Devon: also, prompt for the note in case anyone wants to riff: ```Prompt: "Write a short, passive-aggressive sticky note from the perspective of an office refrigerator complaining about unlabeled leftovers and emotional neglect. Keep it dramatic but funny."```

Sam: challenge: make it rhyme next time. Imagine fridge sonnets.

Leah: small ask — can someone actually label the big Tupperware? The fridge is not our therapist. :pray:

Alyssa: noted. labeling party + pizza + fridge counseling this Friday. who knows, maybe the fridge will become a morale coach. :sparkles:
